idleSub: Tsiba ukuze ubambe ezilungileyo kwaye uweqe ezimbi.
pausedSub: Cofa okanye cinezela u-Enter ukuze uqhubeke ubaleka.
emptySub: Yongeza umxholo kulo mdlalo ukuze ukwazi ukuwudlala.
copyFail: Umbhalo ukhethiwe. Wukope nge-Ctrl okanye Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Umdlalo wokubaleka. Umlinganiswa ubaleka ngokwakhe. Tsiba ukuze ubambe imibono elungileyo kwaye ubaleke embi.
stageHow: Cinezela u-Space, u-Enter, utolo oluya phezulu okanye u-W ukutsiba. Cinezela u-Escape ukumisa okwethutyana. Cinezela u-Tab ukuqhubeka. Yonke into emdlalweni ikwalistiwe phantsi kwesithi Funda ungadlali.
hintKeys: Space, utolo oluya phezulu okanye W ukutsiba
guideText: Bamba into eyinxalenye yenkcazelo yewebhu komponenti. Tsiba phezu kwento engeyiyo iwebhu yemvelo.
